featured.lead: 1.1 is the first release since 1.0 that changes how HelixScreen looks and what it can drive.
body: The home screen becomes a grid you arrange yourself, with new widgets and screens built for ultrawide and portrait panels; filament handling is rebuilt around a new spool editor and works across AFC, Happy Hare, ACE, CFS, the Snapmaker U1 and more; calibration and tuning move to guided screens; and Lua plugins, the HelixPrint companion plugin and a beta BTT K-Touch firmware join the line-up. It also fixes a long list of crashes, hangs and printer-specific problems found since 1.0.

bullets: No more frozen screen when Wi-Fi hangs, and fixes for crashes on reprint and camera stop
Filament systems recover from a Klipper restart instead of sticking on busy
Snapmaker U1, K2 Plus CFS, ACE and AFC fixes: resume, tool changes, box readings
Runout recovery heats the nozzle first; Cool Down turns off every toolhead
Updates and installs that failed on K1 and systemd printers now work, and say why
Plugin installs work on Creality K1-series printers
The QR scanner finds cameras Moonraker lists, and a stock K1's built-in camera
Creality CFS auto-refill shows and sets the right state
Update failures say why, before downloading
Fix for repeated 3D G-code viewer crashes on some GPUs
K2 filament cuts no longer drive the toolhead into the frame
USB prints copy the file to the printer first
Spoolman temperature, spool weight and active-spool fixes
Fixes for crashes at boot with a labeled USB stick and when closing the macro wizard
Saved brightness and screen rotation apply at startup

featured.lead: The second patch release on the 1.0 line.
body: Display sleep is fixed: panels that wedged, glowed or showed a test pattern on AD5X, U1, K1, K2 and Pi DSI now sleep by turning the backlight off, and the screen comes back properly on wake. Several crashes are gone, including the K1 blank-screen crash and crashes after a printer switch. QIDI printers get their .3mf thumbnails back.
